title: Motul M2 Helmet Interior Cleaner
features: Deep cleans and removes grime from helmet interiors
Safe for all types of helmet liners including leather and fabric
Leaves a fresh scent without leaving residue
description:
Built to protect your helmet investment between epic journeys, the Motul M2 Helmet Interior Cleaner from Motul delivers comprehensive hygiene, drying, and surface protection. Built with pH-Neutral Surfactant Safe for EPS Liners & Mirror Finishes, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Direct wipe application or plug-and-play operation).

The Motul M2 Helmet Interior Cleaner from Motul is a must-have maintenance asset for riders who value helmet longevity. It keeps premium EPS liners hygienic, odor-free, and protected between track days and long-haul expeditions.
